items.body:
### Summary

`Task.load()` crashes with an unhandled `IndexError` when an action field contains only whitespace characters (e.g. `"\n"`, `"\t"`, `" "`). The crash happens in `ansible/parsing/mod_args.py`, where `tokens[0]` is accessed without checking that `str.split()` returned a non-empty list.

Discovered by fuzzing `ansible.playbook.task.Task.load` with [Atheris](https://github.com/google/atheris). The fuzzer input that triggered the crash:

```
0a 6e 6e 6e 6e      # "\nnnnn"
Base64: Cm5ubm4=
```



### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

ansible

### Ansible Version

```console
2.21.4
```

### Configuration

```console
-
```

### OS / Environment

Debian

### Steps to Reproduce

from ansible.playbook.task import Task

Task.load({
    "name": "\nnnnn",
    "shell": "",
    "action": "",
    "debug": "",
})


### Expected Results

a clean `AnsibleParserError` with a meaningful message, or the task loading successfully.

### Actual Results

```console
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/fuzz_task.py", line 2, in <module>
    Task.load({"name": "\nnnnn", "shell": "", "action": "", "debug": ""})
    ~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/ansible/playbook/task.py", line 176, in load
    return task.load_data(data, variable_manager=variable_manager, loader=loader)
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/ansible/playbook/base.py", line 168, in load_data
    ds = self.preprocess_data(ds)
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/ansible/playbook/task.py", line 306, in preprocess_data
    (action, args, delegate_to) = args_parser.parse()
                                  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/ansible/parsing/mod_args.py", line 316, in parse
    action, args = self._normalize_parameters(thing, additional_args=additional_args)
                   ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/ansible/parsing/mod_args.py", line 187, in _normalize_parameters
    (action, args) = self._normalize_old_style_args(thing)
                     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/ansible/parsing/mod_args.py", line 285, in _normalize_old_style_args
    (action, args) = self._split_module_string(thing)
                     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^
  File "/home/user/ansible/lib/ansible/parsing/mod_args.py", line 147, in _split_module_string
    result = (tokens[0].strip(), "")
              ~~~~~~^^^
IndexError: list index out of range
```
